output_schema.meaning: Each object contains an auxiliary context field and a final subject field. Acceptance judgments concern subject alone.

input_processing.normalization: Existing long-NIP-19 identifier removal only. Complete remaining post retained. URLs remain in source but prompt excludes them as semantic evidence.

scope: Freeze of the tested subject-generation package, not a production rollout. Existing production prompt defaults, mask pipeline, prominence and hierarchy are unchanged.
limits: Single pilot corpus and assistant semantic review; no population accuracy estimate.
Ten unresolved final subjects and earlier development uncertainties remain counted against gates.
The object-output schema is part of the tested package; do not replace it with the older string-array schema and claim equivalent validation.
No claim that auxiliary context fields enforce any internal reasoning mechanism.
Changes to prompt/model/schema/normalization need separate validation.
